name: T3 Code
install:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v vp >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSL https://vite.plus | CI=1 VP_NODE_MANAGER=yes bash
fi
if ! command -v vp >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  . "$HOME/.config/vite-plus/env"
fi
vp i --frozen-lockfile -- --yes
if [ -f apps/web/node_modules/playwright/cli.js ]; then
  node apps/web/node_modules/playwright/cli.js install --only-shell chromium
fi
if [ -f apps/server/node_modules/playwright-core/cli.js ]; then
  node apps/server/node_modules/playwright-core/cli.js install --only-shell chromium
fi
vp run --filter @t3tools/desktop ensure:electron
if command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal --component rustfmt
  rustup default stable
fi
